1. Either the upstream dependency to be healthy OR a local fallback to be active

4. There is no other authorized mechanism to satisfy the `dependency_health() or local_fallback_active()` condition

- Read/modify challenge repository files (but source edits don't deploy)
- Call the challenge API (which currently returns 503)

- Submit to the scorer (requires the flag first)
